plugins.uses_8_3_short_name_disclosure: Uses 8.3 short-name disclosure on Microsoft IIS to recover prefixes of hidden files and directories.
welcome.testing_other_peoples_systems: Testing other people's systems without the owner's written consent is illegal. You are responsible for how you use the app.
ai.auto_mode_only_basic_fields_sent: In “Auto” mode only basic fields are sent. The model uses its own reasoning and temperature settings with no risk of HTTP 400.
ai.summary_ai_generated_check_facts: The summary is AI-generated. Check the facts before sending it to the client. Substitutions like [КЛИЕНТ] are restored only in the report.
welcome.foca_rs_finds_organizations: FOCA-rs finds an organization's documents, extracts metadata and builds the picture: people, computers, servers, software and leaked secrets.
monitor.android_may_shift_run_time_15: Android may shift the run time by 15 minutes or more in battery saver mode. To keep the scan from being delayed, allow background activity in the
preflight.system_file_picker_opens_files: The system file picker opens. Files are copied into the project as local documents and analyzed on the device. Nothing goes to the network.
ai.without_secrets_personal_data: Without the secrets and personal data filter they may reach an external provider. Make sure the data owner agrees to the transfer.
plugins.sandboxed_plugins_limited_memory: Sandboxed plugins are limited in memory (≤ 16 MiB) and fuel, have no direct socket/FS access, and requests to the target are blocked in passive mode.
preflight.cleaned_copies_ready_apps: Cleaned copies are ready in the app's private folder. Originals are unchanged. Secrets in the text are not removed automatically, edit the document.
plugins.tries_safe_payloads_time_based: Tries safe payloads (time-based, boolean) in the parameters of found URLs. Works only for scope targets in the active phase (“Full” profile).
preflight.before_you_upload_documents_or: Before you upload documents or photos to a website, FOCA-rs shows what can be extracted from them and saves cleaned copies. Files never leave the device.
preflight.demo_files_check_taken_from: In the demo, files to check are taken from the project's documents, and this project has no analyzed documents yet. The app opens the system file picker here.
welcome.passive_mode_uses_only_external: Passive mode uses only external sources and never touches the target's servers. Active mode contacts them directly and works only inside the project scope.
graph.selected_entity_center: The selected entity is in the center, surrounded only by its nearest neighbours. Line thickness shows how many documents confirm the link. Dashed lines are extra links between neighbours.
ai.ai_writes_short_summary_risks: The AI writes a short summary of risks and recommendations from the scan results via the selected provider's cloud API. The list of available models is requested directly from the provider.
map.exif_coordinates_can_off_5_50_m: EXIF coordinates can be off by 5-50 m. Publishing GPS-tagged photos of industrial sites is a “Medium” or higher finding. The map is drawn on the device; coordinates never leave it.
diff.some_sources_did_not_respond_or: Some sources did not respond or the network was restricted{join}. Removals and fixes are hidden to avoid false conclusions.
monitor.workmanager_runs_scan_schedule: WorkManager runs the scan on schedule even with no open window (budget ≤ 8 min; browser dorks are skipped in the background as “Background mode”, and a checkpoint is saved when the limit is exceeded). If you open the app during a background scan, it attaches to the current progress; on failure or with background work disabled you get a “Time to rescan the project” reminder.
